answer.reason: Only DAN 11:6 clearly concerns the king of the north named in the record, and it states one event.

clauses.english: received the king of the south's daughter to make an agreement
clauses.quote: shall come to the king of the north to make an agreement

doubts: Daniel 11 speaks of several kings of the north; DAN 11:7-8, 11, 13, 15 and 40 may concern other kings, so they were left out.
The verses are prophecy, so the clause relates the foretold event as a deed.
